svg.title: Form CR-1: a version inspected and stamped
svg.desc: Form CR-1, CREED's field inspection, filled in four times from policy/policy.json. PHP 8.2 on 2026-10-29: State::Security, stamped Security only. Security fixes only, until 2026-12-31: 63 days left. Plan the move to PHP 8.4 now. PHP 8.2 on 2027-01-01: State::Eol, stamped EOL. End of life since 2027-01-01. In the 90-day grace until 2027-03-31 (89 days left); a named, dated override can carry an app that far. PHP 8.1 on 2026-10-29: State::EolGraceExpired, stamped EOL. Past grace since 2026-04-01. No override applies. The oldest PHP that passes on this day is 8.2. Laravel 13 on 2026-10-29: State::Active, stamped Supported. Active support until 2027-09-30, then security fixes until 2028-03-17. Passes.
